_provenance: Reads no account, makes no API calls, and predicts nothing. Every input here is a decision the team makes (how small an effect is worth acting on) or a quantity swept because it is not knowable from outside Anthropic. No conversion rate, funnel, or revenue figure appears anywhere, because none can be honestly stated before the experiment runs.

test._note: reporting_mde is the effect size the runtime table is drawn at. It is a choice about what is worth acting on, not a prediction of what will happen. Section 1 sweeps it.

eligible_traffic._note: Daily sessions from subscribers who self-declare engineering work. Not knowable from outside, so it is swept rather than assumed.
